title: Push alerts arrive hours late on Android 15
description: Since the 3.4 update, slippery-road push notifications on my Pixel 8 arrive 2-4 hours after the warning was issued. By then I've already driven to work. iOS colleague gets them on time.

title: App crashes when opening map with location off
description: Steps: disable location permission, open app, tap Map tab. App closes immediately. Reproducible every time on iOS 19.1.

title: Wrong municipality shown for Upplands Väsby
description: Warnings for Upplands Väsby are labelled as Sollentuna in the list view.

title: Dark mode text unreadable on settings page
description: Grey text on dark grey background in Settings > Notifications. Hard to read.

title: Android notifications delayed
description: Getting ice warnings way too late on Samsung S24. Battery optimisation is off.

title: Subscription renewal charged twice
description: I was charged 49 kr twice on 2026-11-21 for my yearly Premium renewal. Receipt numbers attached in support ticket.
